// 生成 tests/go/testdata/x509/verify.pem：链验证用的根、中间 CA 和叶子（一次性工具）
package main

import (
	"crypto/ecdsa"
	"crypto/elliptic"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/rsa"
	"crypto/x509"
	"crypto/x509/pkix"
	"encoding/asn1"
	"encoding/pem"
	"math/big"
	"net"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"time"
)

func must[T any](v T, err error) T {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return v
}

var out []byte
var serial int64 = 100

type ca struct {
	cert *x509.Certificate
	key  any
}

var nb = time.Date(2020, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
var na = time.Date(2040, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

func oid(xs ...uint64) x509.OID { return must(x509.OIDFromInts(xs)) }

func mk(t *x509.Certificate, parent *ca, pub, priv any) *ca {
	serial++
	t.SerialNumber = big.NewInt(serial)
	if t.NotBefore.IsZero() {
		t.NotBefore = nb
	}
	if t.NotAfter.IsZero() {
		t.NotAfter = na
	}
	p := t
	signer := priv
	if parent != nil {
		p = parent.cert
		signer = parent.key
	}
	der := must(x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, t, p, pub, signer))
	out = append(out, pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der})...)
	return &ca{must(x509.ParseCertificate(der)), priv}
}

func caT(cn string) *x509.Certificate {
	return &x509.Certificate{Subject: pkix.Name{CommonName: cn, Organization: []string{"Kite Verify"}}, IsCA: true,
		BasicConstraintsValid: true, KeyUsage: x509.KeyUsageCertSign | x509.KeyUsageCRLSign}
}

func leafT(cn string, dns ...string) *x509.Certificate {
	return &x509.Certificate{Subject: pkix.Name{CommonName: cn}, DNSNames: dns, KeyUsage: x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature,
		ExtKeyUsage: []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth}}
}

func ec() *ecdsa.PrivateKey { return must(ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)) }

func main() {
	rk := must(rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048))
	r1 := mk(caT("Root One"), nil, &rk.PublicKey, rk)
	k2 := ec()
	r2 := mk(caT("Root Two"), nil, &k2.PublicKey, k2)
	mk(caT("Root Two"), r1, &k2.PublicKey, k2) // 2 交叉签名
	t := caT("Constrained CA")
	t.PermittedDNSDomains = []string{"example.com"}
	t.ExcludedDNSDomains = []string{"bad.example.com", "foo.example.com"}
	t.PermittedIPRanges = []*net.IPNet{{IP: net.IP{10, 0, 0, 0}, Mask: net.CIDRMask(8, 32)}}
	t.ExcludedIPRanges = []*net.IPNet{{IP: net.IP{10, 9, 0, 0}, Mask: net.CIDRMask(16, 32)}}
	t.PermittedEmailAddresses = []string{"example.com", "boss@other.org"}
	t.ExcludedEmailAddresses = []string{"spam.example.com"}
	t.PermittedURIDomains = []string{".example.com"}
	t.ExcludedURIDomains = []string{"evil.example.com"}
	ki := ec()
	i1 := mk(t, r1, &ki.PublicKey, ki) // 3
	t = caT("PathLen0 CA")
	t.MaxPathLen, t.MaxPathLenZero = 0, true
	i2 := mk(t, r1, &ki.PublicKey, ki) // 4
	i3 := mk(caT("Below PathLen0"), i2, &ki.PublicKey, ki) // 5
	t = caT("ClientOnly CA")
	t.ExtKeyUsage = []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageClientAuth}
	i4 := mk(t, r2, &ki.PublicKey, ki) // 6
	t = caT("Expired CA")
	t.NotAfter = time.Date(2021, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	i5 := mk(t, r1, &ki.PublicKey, ki) // 7
	t = caT("Policy CA")
	t.Policies = []x509.OID{oid(1, 2, 3, 4), oid(1, 2, 3, 5)}
	t.PolicyMappings = []x509.PolicyMapping{{IssuerDomainPolicy: oid(1, 2, 3, 4), SubjectDomainPolicy: oid(1, 2, 3, 40)}}
	t.RequireExplicitPolicyZero = true
	i6 := mk(t, r1, &ki.PublicKey, ki) // 8
	t = caT("NotCA")
	t.IsCA = false
	i7 := mk(t, r1, &ki.PublicKey, ki) // 9
	t = caT("Any Policy CA")
	t.Policies = []x509.OID{oid(2, 5, 29, 32, 0)}
	t.InhibitAnyPolicyZero = true
	i8 := mk(t, r2, &ki.PublicKey, ki) // 10
	t = caT("KeyUsage CA")
	t.KeyUsage = x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature
	i9 := mk(t, r1, &ki.PublicKey, ki) // 11

	lk := ec()
	u := func(s string) *url.URL { return must(url.Parse(s)) }
	l := leafT("ok.example.com", "www.example.com")
	l.IPAddresses = []net.IP{net.IP{10, 1, 2, 3}}
	l.EmailAddresses = []string{"a@example.com"}
	l.URIs = []*url.URL{u("https://api.example.com/x")}
	mk(l, i1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 12
	mk(leafT("bad", "bad.example.com"), i1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 13
	mk(leafT("other", "www.other.org"), i1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 14
	l = leafT("ip")
	l.IPAddresses = []net.IP{net.IP{10, 9, 1, 1}, net.IP{192, 168, 1, 1}}
	mk(l, i1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 15
	l = leafT("mail", "mail.example.com")
	l.EmailAddresses = []string{"boss@other.org", "x@spam.example.com"}
	mk(l, i1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 16
	l = leafT("evil", "evil2.example.com")
	l.URIs = []*url.URL{u("https://evil.example.com:8443/")}
	mk(l, i1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 17
	l = leafT("uriip", "uriip.example.com")
	l.URIs = []*url.URL{u("https://10.0.0.1/")}
	mk(l, i1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 18
	mk(leafT("deep", "deep.example.com"), i3, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 19
	mk(leafT("server", "server.example.com"), i4, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 20
	mk(leafT("under expired", "exp.example.com"), i5, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 21
	l = leafT("policy", "policy.example.com")
	l.Policies = []x509.OID{oid(1, 2, 3, 40)}
	mk(l, i6, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 22
	mk(leafT("notca child", "nc.example.com"), i7, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 23
	mk(leafT("legacy.example.com"), r1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 24
	l = leafT("wild", "*.wild.example.com")
	l.IPAddresses = []net.IP{net.IPv6loopback, net.IP{192, 0, 2, 1}}
	mk(l, r1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 25
	l = leafT("critical", "crit.example.com")
	l.ExtraExtensions = []pkix.Extension{{Id: asn1.ObjectIdentifier{1, 2, 3, 99}, Critical: true, Value: []byte{5, 0}}}
	mk(l, r1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 26
	l = leafT("expired", "expired.example.com")
	l.NotAfter = time.Date(2021, 6, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	mk(l, r1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 27
	mk(leafT("multi", "multi.example.com"), r2, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 28
	l = leafT("anypol", "anypol.example.com")
	l.Policies = []x509.OID{oid(1, 2, 3, 99)}
	mk(l, i8, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 29
	mk(leafT("ku child", "ku.example.com"), i9, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 30
	l = leafT("anyeku", "*.Example.COM")
	l.ExtKeyUsage = []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageAny}
	mk(l, r1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 31
	mk(leafT("wild under constrained", "*.example.com"), i1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 32
	mk(leafT("nosan.example.com"), i1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 33
	l = leafT("many")
	for i := 0; i < 120; i++ {
		l.DNSNames = append(l.DNSNames, "n"+string(rune('a'+i%26))+".many.example.com")
	}
	mk(l, r1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 34
	l = leafT("client", "client.example.com")
	l.ExtKeyUsage = []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageClientAuth}
	l.UnknownExtKeyUsage = []asn1.ObjectIdentifier{{1, 2, 3, 7}}
	mk(l, i4, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 35
	l = leafT("emptyhost", "eh.example.com")
	l.URIs = []*url.URL{u("mailto:x@example.com")}
	mk(l, i1, &lk.PublicKey, lk) // 36
	_ = r2
	must(0, os.WriteFile(os.Args[1]+"/verify.pem", out, 0o644))
}
